alt: John Snow's 1854 map of the Soho cholera outbreak in London, with black bars stacked along streets marking cases clustered around the Broad Street pump.
note: Public domain original map, the real subject. Pale line-art so it needs a strong dark scrim for text; crop tight on the Broad Street cluster. Rejected cand-1 (pub with branding and passers-by) and cand-3 (modern college with logo).
